verdict.summary: The analysis half completed, one edge completed, and the second edge was refused because the harness found a behavioural difference between the original and migrated discovery-service that no verified migration fact and no human decision explained. The refusal is the designed terminal state for an unexplained difference, not a failure of the harness. Run 2 was the final verification; no judging or repair followed it, and the finding was not suppressed, approved, reclassified or narrowed away.

blocking_finding.resolution_required: a human with authority over discovery-service must record a decision through the decision store, or a verified migration fact covering the property must be added. The harness will not manufacture either.

blind_spots.detail: No OCI container runtime: Docker installed but its daemon not running. PERSISTENCE_STATE, QUERY_RESULT and TRANSACTION_EFFECT were never compared; 46 of 82 scenarios are declared gaps; employee-service could not start.
Runtime and scenario evidence covers 4 of 6 modules. configuaration-server fails to start (pre-existing, captured at baseline); employee-service needs MongoDB.
7 of 12 characterization dimensions were never compared on either edge.
Two application tests fail before any migration change, so those two behaviours are unverified throughout.
Coverage is unmeasurable for employee-service; the gate is reported as not evaluated rather than as passed.
Symbol attribution is 0.6858 - above the 0.6 policy floor, well below complete. Roughly a third of symbol relations are unresolved and findings from them are capped at POSSIBLY_AFFECTED.
No sealed evidence manifest, no mechanical evidence-level assignment, no provenance graph and no export exist for either run - stages 18-20 never executed.
J1-005 remains open: every edge is planned at FULL_DIFFERENTIAL, so validation depth carries no information.

The Jakarta boundary is entirely unexercised. EDGE-3-MAJOR-3 carries 33 recipes against 4 for any other edge and has never been run. The most likely place for this migration to fail is the place with the least evidence.
